title: BMW product evidence (read-only snapshot)
description: Immutable copy of a database snapshot. Requirement → version → finding → evidence → source, with the audit trail.

requirements.title: Requirement list
requirements.sql: SELECT key, vehicle, market, status, title, score_total, rank, evidence_grade, finding_count, evidence_count, source_count, last_decision_action, last_decision_actor, open_review_count FROM v_requirement_list WHERE (:vehicle = '' OR vehicle = :vehicle) AND (:market = '' OR market = :market) ORDER BY vehicle, market, rank IS NULL, rank, key

trace.title: Trace a requirement to its sources
trace.sql: SELECT key, version, relation, finding_summary, evidence_content, evidence_location, source_title, source_original_path FROM v_requirement_trace WHERE key = :key ORDER BY version, finding_id, relation DESC

timeline.title: Audit timeline for a requirement
timeline.sql: SELECT t.sequence, t.created_at, t.actor_name, t.actor_role, t.action, t.entity_type, t.rationale, t.event_hash FROM v_audit_timeline t JOIN requirements r ON r.id = t.requirement_id WHERE r.key = :key ORDER BY t.sequence

topic_markets.title: Same topic across markets
topic_markets.sql: SELECT vehicle, topic, market, key, status, score_total, evidence_grade FROM v_topic_markets WHERE (:vehicle = '' OR vehicle = :vehicle) ORDER BY vehicle, topic, market

open_reviews.title: Needs review
open_reviews.sql: SELECT key, vehicle, market, reason, suggested_action, created_at FROM v_open_reviews ORDER BY created_at
